Handover, when this estate is live (apply will write it as handover.sh; plan runs nothing)
  1. first, add the gateway's oci:// address to sourceRepos on AppProject platform (allows only https://github.com/confighub/examples) and storefront (allows only https://github.com/confighub/examples): until then every repoint below is refused
  2. check Argo CD is v3.1 or newer, which is where an oci:// source is read natively; an older one cannot do this at all
  3. repoint Application root at argo-root-children, which would hold AppProject platform, AppProject storefront, ApplicationSet platform-addons, Application storefront. Publish that Space first: a parent left syncing an empty source prunes its children. Nothing above it syncs it, so patch its spec.source in the cluster.
  4. repoint Application storefront at argo-storefront-children, which would hold ApplicationSet checkout-cache, ApplicationSet apptique. Publish that Space first: a parent left syncing an empty source prunes its children. It is a Unit in argo-root-children by this point, so repoint it there and promote, and the repoint is reviewed like any other change.
  5. retire ApplicationSet apptique through its Unit (applicationsSync: create-only, and generators that generate nothing), then run move-applications.sh stage by stage: dev-1-apptique, staging-1-apptique, prod-1-apptique each become a Unit reading its own Space, under the same name, so Argo's tracking does not change and nothing is orphaned
  6. retire ApplicationSet checkout-cache through its Unit (applicationsSync: create-only, and generators that generate nothing), then run move-applications.sh stage by stage: dev-1-checkout-cache, staging-1-checkout-cache, prod-1-checkout-cache each become a Unit reading its own Space, under the same name, so Argo's tracking does not change and nothing is orphaned
  7. retire ApplicationSet platform-addons through its Unit (applicationsSync: create-only, and generators that generate nothing), then run move-applications.sh stage by stage: dev-1-cluster-baseline, staging-1-cluster-baseline, prod-1-cluster-baseline each become a Unit reading its own Space, under the same name, so Argo's tracking does not change and nothing is orphaned
  8. never delete root, storefront, every Application apptique generates, every Application checkout-cache generates, every Application platform-addons generates: resources-finalizer.argocd.argoproj.io deletes everything it deployed. Every step above is a patch for exactly this reason
